ccSwitchParity.claude: 5/5 real requests matched cc-switch.db output_tokens, latency_ms, and first_token_ms to 0ms delta; subagents/*.jsonl and subagents/workflows/*/*.jsonl supported
ccSwitchParity.codex: 6/6 real multi-step requests matched cc-switch.db output_tokens, latency_ms, and first_token_ms to 0ms delta via RequestTimer + token_usage_record
ccSwitchParity.opencode2: 5/5 real requests matched cc-switch.db output_tokens (output + reasoning) and latency_ms (time.streamed - time.created) to 0ms delta
ccSwitchParity.pi: per-request duration/timestamp delta and subagent toolResult unpacking verified
ccSwitchParity.proxyIntegration: read-only ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db 2xx proxy record upgrade (exact ID + ±600s semantic dedup) verified
ccSwitchParity.thresholds: session-log estimated speed requires >=200 output tokens and >=1000ms latency (≈); proxy exact speed requires >=100 output tokens and >=100ms post-TTFT generation

limitations: Uses read-only internal Orca profile state; terminal provider identity may lag up to the next approximately 60-second capture. Local terminal conversations only; native-chat and remote pages return empty.
